tom_tat: Dear Lay Buddhists: My name is Lu Son Kiet, from Ha Nam. One day more than four years ago, during my lunch break, I overheard Ms. Ly Linh tell the magical stories of her and her husband (when they went to Ngu Dai Son...
noi_dung: {align:justify|Dear Lay Buddhists:} {align:justify|My name is Lu Son Kiet, from Ha Nam. One day more than four years ago, during my lunch break, I overheard Ms. Ly Linh telling the miraculous stories of her and her husband (when they went to Ngu Dai Son to celebrate Venerable Dieu Phap) to the people in the workshop. These Cause and Effect retribution stories were so attractive and captivating that I enjoyed listening to them, but did not dare to go near them (for fear of affecting everyone's thoughts), but when I arrived, I saw that almost no one in the workshop avoided me.} {align:justify|After dinner, I couldn't control my emotions (because it was the first time I heard the Buddha's teachings), so I tried to muster up the courage to go to Ly Linh. Luckily, at this time, only she and her husband, Dan Lay Buddhist, were at home. Not only did the two of them not chase me away, on the contrary, they enthusiastically welcomed (a person who was not welcomed by anyone like me).} {align:justify|Ms. Ly Linh and her husband are disciples of Venerable Dieu Phap, I talked to them for three to four hours. Having been thoroughly cleansed by the Buddha's teachings, I not only understood the cause of my illness, but also knew that if I did not repent and correct my mistakes soon, I would definitely fall into endless hell in the future.} {align:justify|What kind of person am I? I would like to tell you, if a child is crying loudly, he only needs to hear an adult say one sentence: - "Lu Son Kiet is coming!" they immediately shut up. My name can help people in the village to scare children, so you must know that my "heroic" achievements are very famous and famous!} {align:justify|Let me give you just a small story (like sesame seeds), so that you can understand how "good" my personality is:} {align:justify|"Many years ago, one day a friend and I were walking on the street, talking and laughing as we walked, then right at that moment. Then suddenly I heard a "tiny" car horn coming from behind. I looked back and saw that it was a big truck. But I still calmly walked on the road, not paying attention to it.} {align:justify|Screech...Screech...Screech! - The sound of the car's horn was loud enough to tear my eardrums, I was startled, the driver shouted: - "DO YOU WANT TO DIE?!} {align:justify|The car The car has now stopped. The driver stuck his head out and continued scolding:} {align:justify|– It's true that you're looking for your own death!} {align:justify|After hearing that, I was on fire. He immediately ran forward and banged on the car, his left hand clutching the car door, his right hand swinging at the driver. Suddenly I discovered: sitting to the right of him was a beautiful girl, so I immediately jumped to the ground, ran around there, opened the car door, used my body to press on the girl's body and slapped my right hand, then beat the driver to a pulp."...} {align:justify|The evil karma created in the past, I only tell a little to everyone, to know how heroic my achievements are. Honestly, I'm very embarrassed to tell, because since I learned about Buddhism, whenever I remember it, I repented and felt extremely sad. Therefore, I was determined to repent and change, vowing from now on to give up evil and reform completely.} {align:justify|Believing that I had converted to evil was a strange thing, so rumors soon spread. Immediately, everyone's slander reached my ears: - "Does Lu Son Kiet want to study Buddhism?... Then even horse shit can bloom!" - "No matter how good Buddhism is, as long as Lu Son Kiet is involved, I won't want to study Buddhism anymore!"...} {align:justify|There are indeed many words that are extremely difficult to hear, but at that time I didn't get angry after hearing them, but even more repentant. It's true that I was so bad that even when I wanted to study Buddhism and be a good person, no one dared to believe me! This is retribution! Whatever you plant, you will reap, there is no mistake.} {align:justify|So I silently made up my mind: "I, Lu Son Kiet, used to live an ugly life, so bad that people would know my face, know my name and run around. Today my body fell into a state of illness, not only was my whole body weak, but I also often suffered from dizziness and lightheadedness. (Dan Lay Buddhist said it was all retribution for hitting people and killing animals)... now that I have heard the Buddha's teachings, clearly understand and believe in the terrifying retribution, I am determined to rebuild my life, vowing from now on to forever be a good person, a good disciple of Buddha. Buddha once said that all Sentient Beings have Buddha nature, so why can't I...?} {align:justify|Of course, if you are determined to reform, you must know how to accept the contemptuous contempt people give you. Didn't the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas once teach:"Once a person who commits a mistake clearly understands the Buddhadharma, he must humbly admit his mistake, be patient, and begin to cultivate and learn right from the insults and curses" or what?} {align:justify|From then on, every time I get home from work, I bury myself in studying the Dharma, not only do I stop eating salty food, but I even give up alcohol and drugs. Even though I used to be an alcoholic (drinking like a sink and smoking like a ship's chimney). Every day I am in front of the Buddha, reviewing my past mistakes, sincerely revealing my repentance, every sin of murder, religion, lust, and delusion, I boldly swear to stop, abandon evil for good...} {align:justify|I bow to a hundred, two hundred, three hundred, a thousand... asking for Dedication of Merit for the creatures I killed, Dedication of Merit for those whom I beat and insulted, Dedication of Merit for those who were bullied by me, bullying... Every single bow of my lips came from my sincere repentance, with tears of repentance flooding my face, I bowed to the point that I didn't even recognize myself as Lu Son Kiet anymore.} {align:justify|Finally, the day came, my fellow monks accepted me, my village neighbors happily greeted me every time they saw me, (the horse shit had bloomed) the "evil" Lu Son Kiet has now turned into a "human", resurrected, changed new, has returned to the position of being human, has human status! Dan Lay Buddhist also led me to take refuge with Venerable Dieu Phap. I was very happy and satisfied, devoting all my strength to starting a new life.} {align:justify|The other night, I dreamed of a tall, very familiar black dog, it was gentle and wrapped around me, I immediately stretched out my arms to hug, caress it and say endless friendly words...} {align:justify|In the morning, when I woke up, my whole body felt light and relaxed. From then on, the illness gradually disappeared without paying attention to the grave.} {align:justify|One day, I suddenly remembered that this black dog was the one I used to strangle, kill, and eat with a rope a few years ago. I owe a lot to the animals' lives and have committed a very serious crime (accumulating karma leads to illness). Thanks to my sincere repentance and chanting the Dedication of Merit, they were pleased to resolve the resentment and erase the hatred. Not only did the black dog not hate me, but in the dream he also seemed friendly, explaining that he was liberated. I am determined from now on for the sake of the creatures I kill to recite the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" and chant it forever...to pray for them. I hope they will soon be reborn in a good land and join me in attaining Buddhahood.} {align:justify|A few years later I am still a "famous" figure but no longer make people panic or fear, on the contrary, when grandparents or someone's parents... teach their children and grandchildren but don't listen, they always use me as an example to remind them:} {align:justify|– "Lu Son Kiet can turn into such a great person, so why can't I change?" what?”…} {align:justify|I have become a model, an example for parents to force their disobedient children to follow! (So ​​this Lu Son Kiet living in the human world is not in vain)...} {align:justify|I understand that. "My mind is controlled by me, my body doing evil or doing good is also controlled by my mind. When the mind changes, everything changes." Thanks to that, I was able to turn from an evil person into a good person, becoming a basic, basic disciple of Buddha. Affliction is Bodhi, all created by the mind!} {align:justify|May those who have dishonest actions (like me) soon return to the right path and attain Bodhi.}

tom_tat: One day in 1993, a farmer named Thi, about 33 years old, went to a large temple in the village to meet Venerable Dieu Phap. Two years ago, Mr. Thi's esophageal wall grew a benign tumor. During surgery...
noi_dung: {align:justify|One day in 1993, a farmer named Thi, about 33 years old, went to a large temple in the village to meet Venerable Dieu Phap.} {align:justify|Two years ago, a benign tumor grew in the wall of Mr. Thi's esophagus. During surgery, the doctor removed a section of the esophagus and sewed it back together with the upper part. But soon, although the cut site had healed, inside the esophagus (where it meets the roof of the mouth), for some reason a round fleshy sprout grew, blocking food, causing him to choke and have difficulty swallowing anything. Although there is no pain, the patient must eat little by little.} {align:justify|After a year, Mr. Thi had to be hospitalized for surgery. Who would have thought that six months later, the flesh sprouted again and surgery was no longer possible. Because it is unclear why polyps keep growing. Mr. Thi was in extreme pain because of this illness. Every time he ate a meal, it was like suffering torture. Luckily, he met a friend named Chuong, the main character in the story "The Golden Feathered Rooster", so he took the liberty to come and ask the Venerable to help him.} {align:justify|The Venerable asked:} {align:justify|– Did you cut down a small tree? Roughly the body is about the size of a pestle? (The monk used his hands to describe)...} {align:justify|The farmer remembered and replied:} {align:justify|– I only cut it down once, this tree grew in the empty land in front of my house, it grew for more than a year, then I used an ax to cut it down. Right now the ax is still there, but... could it be that because of cutting down that small tree, I got esophageal cancer?} {align:justify|This is too strange, beyond what I expected, so the patient is very skeptical. Even though he was confused, Mr. Thi couldn't help but believe it. Because the tree cutting incident happened a long time ago (more than ten years ago), but why does this strange Venerable know so clearly?} {align:justify|Venerable Dharma Talk:} {align:justify|– Trees born in this world are a blessing to humanity. For example, building temples, building houses, building bridges... means that most things that are created rely on it. In the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" it is said very clearly: "The mountain has a mountain god, the earth has an earth god, and the water has a water god", so herbs still have a spirit god to rely on in practice. Therefore, while the tree is not yet mature, you should not arbitrarily cut it down. First: wasting resources, Second:harming the god's wife, so that they can hold grudges and make you sick to pay the consequences.} {align:justify|From now on, you should not intentionally hurt trees, flowers, grass... even if you have to destroy wild grass, you must chant a few Buddhist verses for it before cutting down the roots (because at the base of the grass, many living beings also exist).} {align:justify|You must know that the monks of ancient times, every time they wanted to cut down mature trees, had to climb up. The sound of the announcement asking the gods to move home.} {align:justify|Furthermore, you should develop the mind to become a vegetarian, recite three sets of the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" for the small tree that was cut down, then the cancer in the esophagus will gradually disappear. Do you believe it or not?} {align:justify|– Yes! Where can I go to buy the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" to recite?} {align:justify|– Go to the temple's popular scripture room and request it.} {align:justify|– Thank you, master!}

When we were children, we saw this Chapter, and then watched the movie too} {align:justify|Master said:} {align:justify|– Everyone thinks that this is just a fictional myth written down, but in history there really is this story! Many animals that spend many years cultivating will develop magical powers, especially those that live for a long time, this is absolutely nothing strange.} {align:justify|The white snake transformed into a wife named Bach because during the process of cultivating, she had not eliminated her lustful mind, so she mistakenly fell into an evil path. Just cling to the goal of pursuing love between men and women in the human world. But the laws of nature do not allow humans and animals to live together and engage in such incestuous behavior. No matter how modern and civilized society is today, morality is still difficult to understand. In "The Story of White Snake", Venerable Phap Hai stops White Snake out of great compassion, because if White Snake does not immediately stop the incestuous act, then the next day she will have painful regrets (because in the future she will destroy all her thousand years of karma and have to fall into hell).} {align:justify|Master Phap Hai locked White Snake under the tower. Loi Phong, in fact, is to help her eliminate her lustful mind, let her close the door to practice, self-reflect, see her mistakes!} {align:justify|Nhưng trong “Truyện Bạch Xà” tác giả đã viết hoàn toàn sai lệch: vị sư Pháp Hải từ bi lại bị diễn tả thêu dệt thành giống như ác ma, tác giả biến Phật Bồ-tát thành kẻ bất thông tình lý, tận sức hủy Pháp, báng Tăng, gieo rắc ái tình diễm ảo trong nhân gian, ca ngợi quỷ tà, tô hồng tình yêu, sùng bái ái luyến cực độ. tom_tat: Mr. Go to the hospital...

tom_tat: At a temple in Xi'an, there was a woman about 50 years old who was telling Venerable Dieu Phap about her troubles. She and her husband soon divorced, but the daughter she raised through countless hardships...
noi_dung: {align:justify|At a temple in Xi'an, there was a woman about 50 years old who was telling Venerable Dieu Phap about her troubles.} {align:justify|She and her husband soon divorced, but the daughter she raised through countless hardships (currently a student at the Peking University Research Institute), from birth until now her behavior has been very strange, always liking to fight against her mother. Whenever I tell him to go East, he goes West. For example, he likes to eat stir-fried rice and vegetables, so she immediately makes it delicious for him to eat. It's clear that he's enjoying it passionately, but he keeps pretending that he doesn't like it, sneaking in to say he likes something else and blaming his mother for not following along.} {align:justify|The next day, she does exactly what he asks, then he says he "likes something else, not this"... it sounds so infuriating!} {align:justify|But on the outside, everyone praises her for being a very knowledgeable girl. and is voted the best student of the school every year. Tears flowed freely…} {align:justify|The monk continued:} {align:justify|– When she argued with her husband, the fetus in her womb also started to feel angry with her. It was because of her mistake that he lost his fatherly love in this life. When at home, please sincerely chant and worship three sets of "Luong Hoang Sam". tom_tat: Boys get married and girls get married. It's due to evil or good fate! Without fate, we will not meet! Giving birth to a boy or a girl is asking for debt or paying debt, but looking for No debt is not a mistake! In the summer of 1994, there was a male resident...
noi_dung: {align:justify|Boys get married, girls get married} {align:justify|It's due to evil or good fate!} {align:justify|If there's no fate, there's no meeting!} {align:justify|Giving birth to a boy or a girl} {align:justify|It's a debt collector or a debt payer that comes to you} {align:justify|There's nothing wrong with not having debt!} {align:justify|In the summer of 1994, a male Lay Buddhist over 50 years old came to a certain temple. directed Venerable Dieu Phap to confess his suffering.} {align:justify|He said that in the past, he and his wife had a very good relationship. tom_tat: One afternoon in 1993, someone rang the gate bell. I opened the door and met a woman in her 50s. Behind her were two girls in their twenties (carrying a large bag of rice). I asked her who she was looking for...
noi_dung: {align:justify|One afternoon in 1993, someone rang the gate bell. I opened the door and met a woman in her 50s. Behind her were two girls in their twenties (carrying a large bag of rice).} {align:justify|I asked her who she was looking for, and she said she was looking for me. But I don't know her (and she seems very familiar to me). She turned around and called her daughter into the house. Without waiting for my invitation, she closed the gate herself and entered the living room, then told her two children to drop the bag of rice so they could join her in worshiping Buddha. After they finished the ceremony, I still didn't recognize who she was.} {align:justify|She smiled and said:} {align:justify|– A year ago I went to your brother's house, I was a fried egg seller.} {align:justify|I heard it and suddenly remembered, so I said:} {align:justify|– Oh, sorry, I didn't realize at the moment, please sit down! Is your back okay?} {align:justify|– Yes, it's okay. Today I let my two children carry this bag of rice to thank me... I know you have never accepted gifts, but today you must accept this bag of rice. Because of my brother and that master, I am still alive today...} {align:justify|Listening to her, my thoughts drifted back to the past...} {align:justify|"Last year, a Lay Buddhist acquaintance brought her to my house. Her husband suffered from "spinal disc herniation", and had to stay in bed for 6 years. Although she kindly took care of him, in the end he still could not stand up and passed away half a year ago.} {align:justify|Who would have thought, Mrs. She also had the same illness. Thinking of her husband being sick, spending a lot of money and not being able to save his life, she thought to herself: "It would be better if I died early, so that I wouldn't bother my two children!"... That's why she didn't bother to go to the doctor or take any medicine.} {align:justify|The daughter knew what her mother meant, and was extremely worried, so she went to Avalokitesvara pagoda to pray for Buddha's blessing. Luckily, she met a kind Lay Buddhist (previously he was their neighbor), after knowing what happened Then, he was very sympathetic, and when he heard that the Venerable Dieu Phap had just come to my house, he took her there, asking the master to show him the way to live.} {align:justify|The monk listened to her clearly explain her illness, then asked:} {align:justify|– Is your job related to chicken eggs?} {align:justify|She seemed surprised and said:} {align:justify|– I make a living selling fried egg cakes, making a maximum of ten pounds of eggs a day. Is this case related to my illness?} {align:justify|– Don't you do this to make money?} {align:justify|– Yes, I rely on honest labor to make money, I hope you can show me the cause of my illness…} {align:justify|– Don't blame me for being honest. One kilo is about 11-12 chicken eggs. She calculates that each kilo has only 7-8 eggs. She also sells small chicken eggs at the same price as large chicken eggs and makes a profit from this underweight, is that so?} {align:justify|She replied:} {align:justify|– Yes, everyone does that, to make some money. In fact, it's not like the customer doesn't know, but when buying, no one cares to compare...} {align:justify|– According to Buddhism, what she did was greed and deception. She sells goods and weighs less because she hopes to have a little more money. But "when a drop of water penetrates a stone for a long time, a small evil will become a big disaster", this is the root cause of her illness.} {align:justify|– So my husband is not involved in this, why does he have the same illness?} {align:justify|Master patiently explains:} {align:justify|– Being the same as an illness does not mean the same cause!} {align:justify|For example, a cold or fever - most inflammations usually start from Fever - You may ask, does everyone who sells fried egg rolls also have this disease? This is not certain! For each person from many lifetimes to the present, Cause and Effect overlap in complexity, no one is the same. Reading the newspaper, we see descriptions of car accidents, it's the same accident but some people die miserably, some people are thrown several meters away but are unharmed, they thought they were dead but are alive again... That means there are many strange things beyond our imagination, but in fact this is all related to each person's virtue. Good people, even when faced with evil, can easily turn good, or turn danger into peace. Doing business to make money is normal, it is "heaven and earthly meaning". The ancients said: "A gentleman loves wealth, but if he holds on, he must be virtuous" which means "even though you love money, you must also have ethics when making money." She weighed two amounts short, using this false behavior as a method to make money is not ethical. Furthermore, this is synonymous with "raising a tiger for mischief".Right now, she has earned a large amount of money through weight loss, in the future she will have to spend it all on medical expenses and it won't be enough anymore... If I explain it like that, can you accept it?} {align:justify|– Master, I understand. In the future, she will not be greedy for money and deceive customers.} {align:justify|The monk told her to invite the Buddha statue to worship and worship and repent every day. Because she was illiterate, the Venerable taught her that when bowing to the Buddha, she should recite "Namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva", and release living beings, then her illness could heal.} {align:justify|When she left, she felt her back was much stronger, so she increased her faith in Buddhism.} {align:justify|Unexpectedly, after more than a year, her illness healed. She also came here to express her thanks."...} {align:justify|She saw that I refused to accept the bag of rice, and excitedly said:} {align:justify|– After I left the elder brother's house, every day I thought about my unvirtuous actions, my heart was filled with remorse. The next day, I quickly went to invite the Guan Yin statue to worship, every day I burned incense and worshiped. A maximum of three hundred bows per day, not only did my back not hurt, but it got better and better. But one day, suddenly my back got worse. The pain was so severe that I couldn't stand. My children advised me to go to the hospital.} {align:justify|I said: - If the illness could be cured, my father would not have died. That master was right, I believed him!} {align:justify|Actually, whether I was cured or not, I believed it! Why did I commit the crime of dishonesty? Persevere like that for a whole month.} {align:justify|One night I had a dream and saw Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara appearing in front of me. I quickly bowed my head and asked:} {align:justify|– What do you want to pray for every day?} {align:justify|I said:} {align:justify|– Due to greed for wealth, my back hurts and I have a "herniated disc in my spine", please help me heal my illness every day Always recite Buddha's name and pay homage to Buddha.} {align:justify|Bodhisattva bent down, touched my back, smiled and said:} {align:justify|– You are not sick, if you are sick, how can you kowtow to me?} {align:justify|After speaking, Bodhisattva disappeared. I happily recited His name loudly and sat up on the bed.My two daughters were awakened by my voice and quickly ran to the bed to comfort them. Suddenly they were surprised and happily shouted:} {align:justify|– Mom, you can sit up now!} {align:justify|At this point I discovered that I was able to sit up on my own. Recalling the situation in my dream, suddenly my back felt warm and warm, extremely comfortable and relaxed. At this point, I realized that my illness had healed. My heart was so touched that I couldn't hold back the tears. I told my two children about the dream, they didn't quite believe it.} {align:justify|I asked my two children to help me up, they helped me take a few steps, my back didn't hurt at all, it's just that my legs were still a bit weak, I understood that this was because I had been lying in bed for more than a month. So my parents and I were so happy that we couldn't sleep.} {align:justify|The illness had completely healed. My heart is filled with gratitude to Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara, and at the same time I remember my husband who is now a handful of ashes and bones. If he had met the Buddha Dharma, wouldn't he have been saved? So I decided to return to my hometown, visit his grave, boasting that I had come back to life from the dead.} {align:justify|After visiting the grave, my relatives invited me to visit for a few days, I agreed. During my time in the countryside, I saw people harvesting a lot of rice left over. I asked the people in the village:} {align:justify|– The leftover rice is so bad, why isn't anyone gleaning it all?} {align:justify|They replied: - Nowadays, everyone's family is well-off, so they don't bother to put their heads in the sun to glean rice anymore.} {align:justify|I asked: -So... can I glean it?} {align:justify|They replied: - There's nothing wrong with that, a few days later all the straw will be burned down.} {align:justify|Stopping for a moment, she continued:} {align:justify|– I saw that there was so much rice left that it would be a waste to burn it all, so I spent a week gleaning rice, and gleaned four huge hugs. Grind it into 98 kilograms of rice. Today I brought 50 kilograms to you. This is not an offering, but to let you know that my back is truly healed (that's why I can bend for so long to glean that much rice!) It's like Buddha Bodhisattva has given me life for the second time! I often ask my daughter to help me chant the Dedication of Merit for Sentient Beings. We respectfully give you this bag of rice to share the joy with us.} {align:justify|I smiled and said:} {align:justify|– I don't dare accept your offerings, please bring them to the temple to make offerings to the monks, because they are the Buddha's representatives in the human world. Furthermore, Venerable Dieu Phap is also a monk! oneself and cannot secretly repent. Considering that he is older than her, he has had more time to create karma, his greed is bigger and bigger, and his mistakes are even more "huge"!} {align:justify|This girl has an honest personality and has not lost her purity and innocence. As for me, I am extremely hot-tempered, with all the mistakes of stupidity, greed, anger, etc. - if I don't practice early, the tragic future is unimaginable.} {align:justify|Cause and Effect stories arise next to me, constantly warning and motivating me: "You must try to practice, time does not wait for you!"}

tieu_de: 17. DESIRE FOR A SMALL PROFIT AND A BIG LOSS
tom_tat: A girl about 27-28 years old, sometimes her headphones work well, sometimes she doesn't. Went to the hospital for a check-up, the doctor said there was no illness, but her hearing was still not clear, I don't know why? Master asked: - You work constantly...
noi_dung: {align:justify|A girl about 27-28 years old, her headphones sometimes work, sometimes they don't. Went to the hospital for a check-up, the doctor said she wasn't sick, but her hearing was still unclear, she didn't know why?} {align:justify|The master asked:} {align:justify|– What was your job related to having your ears... full of change like that?} {align:justify|She was momentarily bewildered and confused, unable to respond.} {align:justify|I explained to her on behalf of the master:} {align:justify|– These coins. It didn't belong to her, but because she wanted some profit, she took this money for her own use. That's why her ears got sick, not because she had money in her ears! Please check to see if this is really the case?} {align:justify|She immediately replied that she was a cashier at a gas station. Every day when checking accounts, she usually has a lot of change, only about a dime or two, because customers don't need change so they leave it behind. Every day she goes to work and comes back by bus. Finding it convenient, she used these few coins to pay for the bus fare. She said that this was not embezzlement.} {align:justify|I said:} {align:justify|– This is not embezzlement, but greed, right?} {align:justify|She seemed embarrassed, nodding awkwardly.} {align:justify|Master asked:} {align:justify|– From now on, will you still be greedy for this change?} {align:justify|She said with finality:} {align:justify|– That's good!} {align:justify|As soon as Master finished speaking, she exclaimed in surprise:} {align:justify|– My ears can hear very clearly now!} {align:justify|Master smiled and said:} {align:justify|– I can't see any change in my ears now, but I still see "ham, fruit and soft drinks"... what is this?} {align:justify|Miss Eyes widened in surprise, screaming:} {align:justify|– Oh my God, how can He... see through everything?! Sometimes when checking out, customers give us a few extra coins. We often use that to buy ham, fruit, drinks, etc. for lunch. Is this still considered a crime?} {align:justify|– I'm a cashier, so I can't calculate wrongly. Money that belongs to public funds should not be used privately, I do not have the right to do so arbitrarily?} {align:justify|She nodded repeatedly:} {align:justify|– You are right. From now on, I don't dare to do that anymore.} {align:justify|– If you say something, you must keep it!} {align:justify|She happily stood up and said:} {align:justify|– Master, my ears are completely clear, are you "Giving power" to me?} {align:justify|I answer for master:} {align:justify|– This is the result of the power (she just repented) of vowing to overcome material temptation, determined not to make mistakes again!} {align:justify|She was very happy, moving on to another question:} {align:justify|– My eyes have often felt dull and blurry for the past few years. Point it out and see that there's nothing, but the eyelids are always red, is there retribution due to some other wrongdoing?} {align:justify|The Master replied without thinking:} {align:justify|– You know that self-reflection like that is good! I see a lot of detergent in your eyelids!} {align:justify|She shouted:} {align:justify|– Oh! I know! We work at a gas station and have to use soap to clean stains, so every day we work, we often use laundry detergent to wash our hands. Because work at the store is not very busy, we girls, when we have free time, often take the time to wash our clothes, then bring clothes and household items to the store, and use this soap to do laundry - saving time on housework, washing powder and water.} {align:justify|– You girls do this because you are greedy, because you have requisitioned and encroached on national property and work time, that is a mistake, because you have taken "public property" that should not be taken, right. no?} {align:justify|She nodded:} {align:justify|– I never thought that doing so was a crime. So haven't I become a bad person? – She said with tears in her eyes.} {align:justify|I couldn't help but interject:} {align:justify|– When I didn't know Buddhism, I behaved just like you. In the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" it is said: "There is nothing that Sentient Beings in this world can think of that does not create karma, there is nothing that does not create sin." Because people living in this world of desire, whether more or less, have the habits of greed, anger, and ignorance. If you are sick, the cause is due to greed, not understanding the Dharma, not understanding the reason. Once you know how to repent, your illness will go away.} {align:justify|The compassionate Master added:} {align:justify|– From now on you must study many scriptures to increase your wisdom.Regarding work, she needs to do a lot of devotional work, in order to atone for her greed for the agency's resources.} {align:justify|When she left, she felt that her eyes were much better, so her heart was filled with faith and respect for the Buddha Dharma.}

tieu_de: 18. THE KINDNESS OF THE THREE STATUE TREE
tom_tat: In 1994, I still lived in a ground floor house with one gate and one yard. During the Mid-Autumn Festival, the herbs and flowers in the yard still flourish forever. Entering the gate, on the left is my living room and study room. Statue Tree...
noi_dung: {align:justify|In 1994, I still lived in a ground floor house with one gate and one yard. During the Mid-Autumn Festival, the wonderful herbs and flowers in the yard still flourish forever.} {align:justify|Entering the gate, on the left is my living room and study room. The Ba Tuong tree is placed next to the window. In the yard there is a flower trellis, to the right of the window is a writing desk with a beautiful, delicate Van Truc pot.} {align:justify|This afternoon, my high school son did not go to class. After lunch, he went to the study room to do his homework and write. As for me, I lay in my room reading books, waiting for the Venerable Master Dieu Phap to arrive.} {align:justify|After four o'clock the gate bell rang, I went out to welcome the monk and his attendant into the study. The 16-year-old son clasped his hands to greet his master and then continued to focus on his work.} {align:justify|After sitting down, Venerable Dieu Phap asked my child:} {align:justify|– Are your feet smelly?} {align:justify|The boy blushed and said:} {align:justify|– When I was 12-13 years old, my feet started to smell, no matter how I cleaned them, my father ordered me half an hour ago. I opened the window to let the air circulate... But you still smell bad? What a mistake! Let me go to the other room!} {align:justify|Master stopped, smiled and said:} {align:justify|– Honestly, I didn't hear anything foul! But just now when you paid me your respects, all the plants in the house came to pay my respects. This Van Truc pot alone told me about your condition. It said you weren't concentrating this afternoon. You were distracted while playing, so you couldn't write much! In addition, he also complained that the foul smell coming from his feet made him want to suffocate!…} {align:justify|Hearing the Venerable say that, my child was so frightened that his eyes widened and his tongue froze; His face became even redder, he awkwardly turned to look at me because he was afraid of being scolded.} {align:justify|I smiled and said to the master:} {align:justify|– Our little boy is still like that, at parent-teacher meetings, the teacher always tells me that he's sitting in class and looks very dignified (like listening to the lecture very attentively), but no matter how many times he calls out to him, he still won't listen... No matter how I teach, he won't correct me. But fortunately, his academic performance is better than before. But its feet were as if they were at the head of the wind, emitting "incense" that flew as far as... eight miles! Is there any way to treat it?} {align:justify|When I spoke, the Venerable just closed his eyes, a moment later, he said:} {align:justify|– The Ba Tuong Ba tree in my house comforted Van Truc, saying it "has a way to help". Let me tell you the story: - "Use two of its leaves (like this) and work hard... use it once and it will be good." (Please forgive me for not being able to explain more clearly, because I want to avoid the Ba Tuong Ba tree from getting into trouble).} {align:justify|Even though in the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" it was said that "flowers, grass and trees all have consciousness"... but when I heard the master tell the story of plants that can converse, it made me feel very curious and interesting... so I asked:} {align:justify|-Dear master, what are the shapes of the Tuong Ba and Van Truc trees when talking to you?} {align:justify|– Tree Tuong Ba has the shape of an adult, wearing blue ancient clothes, while Van Truc has the shape of a teenager, his hair is in a bun like the princes of the past, also wearing blue clothes, but looks more delicate and slender... The flowers in my house are mostly in the shape of little girls, their clothes are as beautiful as the color of flowers. It's also possible that this is all an illusion, just a form of conveying information, a miracle of nature. Buddha said: "Everything that has a form is an illusion." And in the Heart Sutra it says: "Form is emptiness and emptiness is form, feelings, thoughts, actions, consciousness... are all the same." So you shouldn't accept the appearance.} {align:justify|But I still accept it, and ask:} {align:justify|– Of course plants have consciousness, so when you cut off two of its leaves, does it feel pain?} {align:justify|– Yes, just now Tuong Ba asked me to convey the message for him, he begged me, "When you finish cutting two of its leaves, remember to take some soil from the flower bed and apply it to the wound to stop its pain." Also, he said that he has followed me in reciting sutras and studying Buddhism, so I don't use white wine to wash or water him anymore, because he also wants to keep the precepts and not drink too much. In order to help Van Truc, he volunteered to sacrifice two leaves. This was because he wanted to learn the Buddha's spirit of almsgiving. Besides, he also really wanted to repay the kindness of his children for taking care of them every day, so he willingly endured the pain and donated the leaves to make medicine like that.} {align:justify|After hearing this, I was very moved and became even more confident that these were the correct words (Because my friends once told me that the Tuong Ba plant loves wine, they told me to remember to add a little wine to the water for the Tuong Ba every week, so it will grow stronger and more luxuriant).} {align:justify|Through my master's words, I suddenly remembered an article that said: "Flowers also have likes and dislikes, if they are placed next to the species they like, they will grow quickly, and if placed next to herbs, If it hates it, its growth rate will be sluggish.''...} {align:justify|Last year, there was an article that reported that a scientist discovered during research that: when a forest encounters a major fire, the detector detects the heartbeat (feelings) of the burned trees, emitting a very sad and desperate signal and quickly transmits this fire news to other trees. But when there is no fire, the emotion meter turns out to be very normal like humans and animals Objects, there are also seven feelings and six desires.} {align:justify|From that day on, I have adhered to what Buddha preached in the Lang Nghiem Sutra such as "when you die, you become a human, when you die you become a goat; Dead herbs become people, dead people become herbs''... the more I believe and remain steadfast, I also understand the reason why the Buddha said: "Pure Bodhisattvas and Bhikkhus, when walking on the road, you should not trample on plants, let alone reach out to pick them off"...} {align:justify|That very evening, we did the same as Ba Muoi Statue with Venerable Dieu Phap, and my son's feet stopped smelling. What happened in my house is exactly like a myth.} {align:justify|This reminds me of the divine physicians like Ly Thoi Tran, Ton Tu Mac, etc. They were able to understand which plants had what medicinal properties and wrote the books "Thien Kim Phuong", "Bon Thao Cuong Mu", clearly explaining the wonderful medicine, to help the world. They must have been able to interact with herbs, so they possessed an immeasurable level of knowledge about herbs that brought such blessings to humanity.} {align:justify|From then on, my family and I no longer had the intention of harming any plants, and could not even bear to trample the small plants on the road.} {align:justify|Up to now, humanity has entered the 21st century, and is conscious of maintaining a balanced ecological environment. This concept is increasingly popular and penetrates deeply into people's hearts. But I realize that no one can protect the environment more perfectly than the Buddha, because every word and every sentence He advised people to "love living creatures", flowers and plants... existed since ancient times, but now when I read it, I still find it very new, reasonable, full of compassion and bright wisdom.}

tieu_de: 19. MUST SEE THE ADVANTAGES OF PEOPLE
tom_tat: One afternoon last fall, a dozen Lay Buddhist Shijiazhuang arrived at Wutai Mountain. Among them was a woman over fifty years old, staying at the guest house and telling Venerable Dieu Phap her suffering: - "Silver...
noi_dung: {align:justify|One afternoon last fall, a dozen Shijiazhuang Lay Buddhists arrived at Wutai Mountain. Among them was a woman over fifty years old, staying at the guest house to talk to Venerable Dieu Phap about her suffering:} {align:justify|– "Master! I have been taking refuge in Buddha for 4 years, fasting every full moon and first day, but my body is not very healthy.} {align:justify|Half a year ago I met a wise man and realized that if I want my body to be completely disease-free and healthy, I must stop eating salty foods and not eat blood. Sentient Beings meat. Unexpectedly, after I cut off meat and fish, my body became stronger and healthier. Only then did I realize that eating Tam Puren meat was only a temporary means.} {align:justify|Since then, I have often advised my children to become vegetarian to avoid getting sick in the future, but they are also shy, thinking that I am becoming more and more superstitious and foolish when studying Buddhism I wanted to nourish my child, which made me angry.} {align:justify|So I often argued with them, but no one listened, making the atmosphere in the house very tense. Recently, I really couldn't bear it, so I had to stay at a friend's house to apologize and pick me up, but every time it was time to eat, everyone felt very uncomfortable.} {align:justify|I thought I wanted to become a monk, but I was worried about not being able to leave home. "I'm thinking of going to a nursing home, but I'm afraid they won't help me eat a good vegetarian diet. I'm feeling very miserable right now. Please have mercy on me."...} {align:justify|Venerable Dieu Phap sat cross-legged silently listening from beginning to end.} {align:justify|When she finished speaking, he opened his eyes and said:} {align:justify|-"People who study Buddhism must know how to live in harmony with the masses, this is to practice the habit of respecting others when choosing a religion Even when dealing with your children, you should not force them to obey and obey. She hopes that her children will believe in Buddhism and become vegetarians, of course for their own good. However, they must also know how to observe their fundamentals and not be in a hurry to achieve success quickly. Doing so will be counterproductive and cause misunderstandings and resistance towards Buddhism.} {align:justify|While eating, you can use two trays at one table. You should not resent them because you eat meat. She must often ask herself: "How long has it been since I've been precepting myself to killing and cutting meat?" If you practice well, why haven't you escaped the six paths yet? Buddhas and Bodhisattvas do not hold on to attachments and never let go like we do.} {align:justify|Therefore, if you want to save people, you must study the opportunity and method. In addition to verbal preaching, you need to use physical teachings, this is very important.} {align:justify|For example, when you see a woman studying Buddhism as a vegetarian, her countenance is getting better and better, her body is getting stronger and her mind is becoming more gentle and peaceful; They will naturally believe in Buddhism. Gradually, thanks to her silent good changes, the children will be inspired and will automatically turn to her for refuge. Of course, if you want to save others, the most important thing is that you yourself must devote yourself to practicing properly, being righteous but not evil, enlightened but not delusional. If you want to correct others, you must first correct yourself.} {align:justify|In addition, you must be able to do this, often saying three good things:} {align:justify|You must often say your children are good, even if they are not good, say good.} {align:justify|You must often say your life is good, even if it is not good, also say good.} {align:justify|You must often say good things to your relatives and friends, even if they are not good, still say good things.} {align:justify|From now on, elders must remember these three things in their hearts and keep them at the corner of their mouths. "Consistence is eternal happiness".} {align:justify|Whether it's a child or a relative or neighbor, even if they were previously unsatisfactory towards you, thanks to her always hiding evil and bringing good, knowing how to repay evil with virtue, over time, the other person will repent and feel ashamed, correct their mistakes and change. If you often say three good things, of course you will be respected by everyone, your life will naturally get better and better.} {align:justify|On the contrary, if you are always afraid of people not respecting you, always talking up to your elders, always relying on authority, relying on power, acting superior, here I am! - living a life that is scrutinized, trying to find fault with others, this is very wrong, very contrary to one's vow, it will create a gap between children, relatives, and friends. Behaving like that will cause constant conflicts, leading to the hearts of both ourselves and others... bursting with resentment!} {align:justify|For the same reason, the practice of "three good things" is very suitable for everyone to apply. If you cannot practice, no matter whether you are old or young, husband or wife, monk or layperson, you will embrace endless troubles"...} {align:justify|After listening to master Dharma's talk, the woman kept nodding, all her withering sadness had disappeared, her gloomy autumn face had turned into a cheerful, warm spring color.} {align:justify|Buddhism is truly a wonderful dharma, Venerable Dieu Phap is truly a wonderful dharma, he is always a wonderful dharma. He skillfully explains profound Buddhist principles so that religion and world can both understand and harmonize without hindrance and doubt.}

tom_tat: Bewitched ladders are like... falling down walls... Many people are so infatuated that it's hard for them to stop smoking, gambling, and their mind is addicted to alcohol and lust... they tie themselves up. If anyone is free from this affliction, it is the Tathagata - king of freedom. A guy...
noi_dung: {align:justify|Infatuated with the ladder is like... falling down on a wall... Many people who are addicted to it have a hard time giving up smoking, gambling, their minds are addicted to alcohol, lust... they tie themselves up. If anyone is free from this affliction, it is the Tathagata - the king of freedom.} {align:justify|A student in his early twenties asked Venerable Dieu Phap a question: -When I was a child, I heard my grandmother tell me about the past life and the next life, saying that whenever the King of Hell reincarnates someone, he first makes them drink a cup of Manh Ba's "bewitching thang", and after drinking it, they forget all about their previous life. I would like to ask master, is there really such a thing as drinking this enchanting soup?} {align:justify|Venerable Dieu Phap replied:} {align:justify|– Whether I say yes or no – I cannot give you proof. And those who were originally friends, as close as hands and feet, also turned their backs on "money", turned against each other and turned into enemies, even leading to "you die, I live, swear it's a death or death". This is all due to drinking the bewitching "money" of Manh Ba and "forgetting" everything.} {align:justify|Viet Vuong Cau Tien wanted to take revenge on Ngo Phu Sai, so he had to lie down and taste honey. Could it be that he really forgot the humiliation of losing his country and accepted to serve and serve Ngo Phu Sai? This is just a pretense, a lie; because the bottom of Viet Vuong's heart is filled with hatred, just waiting for the opportunity to avenge his revenge, "not because he doesn't take revenge, but because the time hasn't come yet"...} {align:justify|A life after reincarnation means only exchanging the outer layer of rotten skin, in terms of appearance it seems like there is a real "change of head and face", but the woman's consciousness inside this body of four great beings still knows clearly (objectively) about the past, who should repay the favor. towards someone who collects debt... That's why there is a saying: "Good is rewarded with good, evil is rewarded with evil".} {align:justify|Led by karma, whenever you need to come, you must definitely come, if you need to go, you will definitely go. You definitely cannot let go of your likes and dislikes, increase or decrease.} {align:justify|So being confused by the "delusion ladder" is the habit of greed, anger, and ignorance obscuring the inherent Buddha nature, causing Sentient Beings to go crazy, circulating in life and death.}

tom_tat: Lac Duong street, Ha Nam province has a family of three people, the husband is honest, the wife is diligent and responsible. Their daughter is 17 years old, beautiful and lovely. At first glance, this is a warm, happy family...
noi_dung: {align:justify|Lac Duong street, Ha Nam province has a family of three people, the husband is honest, the wife is diligent and responsible. Their daughter is 17 years old, beautiful and lovely. At first glance, it appears that this is a warm and happy family, but it is true that the proverb "Every house has its sufferings that are hard to talk about".} {align:justify|On a fortuitous occasion, the female owner directed me to confess her unspeakable sufferings over the years.} {align:justify|She and her husband came from the countryside, and before getting married, they had no feelings or knew each other before. It was just that when they met, she saw that he was quiet and cautious in his gestures, so she thought to herself: "This is a man with good manners and style, worthy of my support"... so she agreed to get married.} {align:justify|After getting married, she discovered that her husband had too many shortcomings that she couldn't handle.} {align:justify|For example, when he ate, he chewed his teeth very coarsely. She said that if he ate noodles, the neighbors upstairs and downstairs could clearly hear him chewing, swallowing, and slurping. And when eating, even though his nose was "flowing like a river", he didn't bother to wipe it or raise his head, he just kept his head down - regardless of whether there were guests at home or not -} {align:justify|Moreover, when he farted, he let it out very naturally, without any hesitation or shyness, fireworks from his butt kept exploding, continuously or sporadically... making those present feel extremely confused and embarrassed, but he remained calm and awake. Dry as if there was no rust. No matter how bitterly she advised, her husband remained as indifferent as "an elm tree with all its bark peeled off", just "I am as I am", with an unchanged appearance.} {align:justify|The stories told like this sound very trivial, but there have been countless quarrels between husband and wife because of this. She saw that her husband was truly willing to let people laugh at him, let the world gossip about him during his drinking sessions without knowing any shame, as if he had no face... he made her and her daughter extremely embarrassed in front of outsiders!} {align:justify|Therefore, many times she discussed divorce, but was often dissuaded by friends and relatives. As for her, whenever she sees her husband, her heart is filled with frustration and sadness.} {align:justify|Her daughter has lacked her father's love since childhood.(She has never been held, played with, or taken out to play by him.) For her father, she is also filled with dissatisfaction, because she rarely gets to talk and communicate with her father, and he treats her like a stranger.} {align:justify|Up to now, whenever mother and child are talking and laughing, as soon as he enters the house, they immediately shut up.} {align:justify|Since taking refuge in Buddhism, her daughter and grandmother have both given up eating salty foods. Every day she persistently practiced the morning and evening sessions, diligently chanting sutras and mantras. Her daughter is busy with school, so every day on the road she always takes advantage of the Great Compassion Mantra. It seems like she is very diligent and diligent.} {align:justify|For all matters, she can let go, let go of everything. The husband's only problem is that his mind often becomes upset. She always hoped that through practice, the sufferings of marriage would be reduced. Who knew that since she became a vegetarian, the smell from her husband's body was unbearable, so she had to live in separate rooms, no one cared about her.} {align:justify|They have been sleeping separately for three years now, and she was waiting for her daughter to go to college to get a divorce. Because she has to face afflictions and suffering every day, she often has headaches and is very sick.} {align:justify|Looking at the woman who was talking and crying, she was only over 40 years old, but was tormented by an unhappy marriage and tortured by illness, making her emaciated. I know that this is a gathering of evil fates from previous lives, and it is not easy for ordinary people like me to resolve, so I called to ask for advice from Venerable Dieu Phap. The master was silent for a moment and then explained to me the past lives of the mother, daughter and husband:} {align:justify|"This female Lay Buddhist in her previous life was a poor man Go, if you can get the shell to sell, you will definitely become rich and make a lot of money!} {align:justify|Mr.justify|He was so happy to have fulfilled his dream, so he took the ax and started peeling off the bark of the tree. After working for a long time, he was tired, so he set his ax on the ground, climbed up to a three-tree tree to lie down and sleep.} {align:justify|While sleeping soundly, he suddenly saw a young man wearing a green shirt kneeling in front of him and crying, saying that he was an elm tree, who had been cultivating for thousands of years. Only three more years to go before he attains enlightenment and becomes an immortal. If all the bark is peeled off now, we will be in a situation where "our efforts will be exhausted", so please ask Mr. So that three years later, when I come to peel the shell, I will cultivate to become an immortal and then repay my gratitude. After speaking, he immediately bowed to Mr. I need to get married, I can't wait three years!} {align:justify|Then Mr. Mr. X finally peeled off all the elm bark and carried it to the pharmacy. The shop owner happily checked the goods and weighed and measured them. Mr. If I lie, I will be your child!} {align:justify|That Mr. The proverb says: "People need face, trees need bark!"} {align:justify|Didn't the female Lay Buddhist often say that her husband behaved like: "A stripped elm tree" with no face, no skin, no face? Indeed, what she said was very right! You must know that the personality, customs and what people have encountered or experienced in their previous lives are very relevant to this life.} {align:justify|The pharmacy owner actually has two ounces of Mr. So now he must be born as a child, but no longer as a boy but as a girl. Because it was he who initiated, pointed out and incited Mr. That's why in this life he has to be reincarnated as a child in a family that is against him (having a female body is much more miserable than a male body), not to mention being a child who is not loved or cared for by his father, so isn't that suffering even more suffering?This is also the reason for the unusual, extremely cold relationship between father and daughter.} {align:justify|Understanding the Cause and Effect of the previous life in this life, the female Lay Buddhist and her daughter need to sincerely repent of their previous life's sins. She needs to repent to her husband in this life. Daughters must also persevere in repentance to erase the resentment in their father's heart (the reason why he is such an unreasonable person today is because of the actions that mother and daughter did in their previous lives). In the future, the mother and daughter must sincerely repent, and recite the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" 49 times for the sake of the "old elm tree".} {align:justify|When the conditions meet and the time comes, then the family relationship of all three will definitely improve, enjoying profound love.} {align:justify|Perhaps thanks to female Lay Buddhist and her daughter's dedication to practice (diligently chanting sutras, reciting mantras, fasting and reciting Buddha's name for nearly three years now), they were inspired.
