His family had thousands of thousands of wealth, and he maintained strict precepts, making everyone admire him very much. (It seems that studying Buddhism is not difficult for rich people? The key lies in whether you have wisdom and are destined to be with Buddha).} {align:justify|His son Trinh Vi has just entered high school. One day he was leaving school with his friends. In the group, X was hungry, so he bought a cake. As soon as he took a bite, X spit it out and threw the cake away.} {align:justify|Trinh Vi asked:} {align:justify|– Why did you throw the cake away?} {align:justify|X said:} {align:justify|– So bad! It doesn't taste good.} {align:justify|While answering, X walked closer to the cake he just threw. With his foot, he kicked it a few more meters away. Trinh Vi quickly ran to pick up the cake, gave it to his friend, and said gently:} {align:justify|– Don't throw away the cake like that, it's a waste, please eat it. Wasting food is a big sin!} {align:justify|X sneered and said:} {align:justify|– I bought this cake, if you don't like it then throw it away, what's the crime? If you're afraid of wasting, then eat it yourself!} {align:justify|Trinh Vi said:} {align:justify|– Then I'll eat it for you!} {align:justify|After speaking, he immediately ate that cake. When Trinh Vi's mother told the Venerable about this, her eyes turned red. She said she cried when she heard her son recount that situation.} {align:justify|After listening, the monk looked for a long time at his son sitting quietly next to his mother, smiling and praising:} {align:justify|– Good son, studies well, his future is extremely bright!} {align:justify|Trinh Vi's father said:} {align:justify|– Trinh Vi loved to sit still when he was young, sometimes he played around in the house, but when he looked for it, he couldn't find it. where. Because I didn't hear the sound of the gate opening, the child and his mother were very confused. They went to look for it when they suddenly heard a noise in the closet. We opened the cupboard, looked in and saw the boy sitting solemnly in there, eyes closed, mouth not saying a word, but as if reciting something. I pulled him out and asked:} {align:justify|– Why are you sitting here?} {align:justify|He replied: – I don't know.} {align:justify|– Master, tell me, does this boy have a relationship with Buddha?He always said he wouldn't get married in the future, so he didn't bother causing trouble.} {align:justify|The monk said:} {align:justify|– That's right! You try to raise him well, so that he can become a good intellectual for Buddhism, and in the future he will make great contributions to the religion.} {align:justify|Ba Trinh Vi said:} {align:justify|– I have been thinking about something that I don't understand, and I've been wondering for many years. Please ask for an assistant professor. I originally only had a high school diploma, then when I met an opportunity, I only planned to do a small business, but I didn't expect it to be extremely prosperous and extremely favorable, until now. My career is so successful that sometimes it makes me wonder. Because there are many people with very high degrees, who are extremely intelligent, and even go to work earlier than me, but they never prosper, or they prosper for a few years and then collapse. But I not only prosper smoothly, but am also lucky enough to meet Buddha's teachings, know how to recite Buddha's name, chant sutras, print sutras, create Buddha statues... my business is getting better and better. This cannot be said to be without blessings. Master, can you explain to me, what good cause did I plant in the past to get the results I have today?} {align:justify|Master said:} {align:justify|– This problem must be meditated upon yourself, diligently achieved, then you will understand clearly. Surely you're in business, from morning to night you're always worried about making money, and don't have time to meditate? To help Trinh Vi and everyone understand Cause and Effect, I will tell you a story:} {align:justify|"When Buddha Shakyamuni was in the world, one time, there were more than a thousand Buddhist disciples sitting in the lecture hall, attentively listening to him preach the Dharma. At that time, there was a Bhikkhu sitting at the far end, near the big gate. Suddenly a rumbling sound rang out in his stomach, but because the surrounding Bhikkhus were paying attention to the Dharma, no one paid attention. This Bhikkhu suddenly heard laughter behind him, immediately turned his head to look, and saw outside the gate a boy about 9 years old laughing, chewing something, holding half a cake in his hand, softly asking:} {align:justify|– Are you hungry?} {align:justify|The Bhikkhu nodded. So the boy gave half the cake to the Bhikkhu and then turned around and crawled to continue playing.} {align:justify|The monk told his father Trinh. Vi:} {align:justify|That child is your predecessor. By giving a monk half a cake when he was hungry, he helped him steadfastly listen to the Dharma. This merit is extremely great. This is the reason why he is rich and prosperous in this life.} {align:justify|In the "Ksitigarbha Sutra" it is said: "In the future, if there are good men and good women who, in the Buddha Dharma, plant a little good root with a grain of sand, a strand of silk, a strand of hair, the benefits they will receive cannot be exemplified... In the future life, if there are good men and good women who encounter a Mahayana sutra, or hear a sentence or a verse, develop a heart of gratitude, praise and reverence, and give alms and offerings, then that person receive great blessings that are immeasurable and boundless, if one can Dedication of Merit to the Dharma world, this blessing cannot be compared'.} {align:justify|That child, out of curiosity, came to the gate of the lecture hall to listen to a few Buddhist Dharma sentences. He may not have clearly understood the meaning, but in many later lives, from then until now, the predestined relationship has ripened, not only has he become a Buddhist disciple, but he is also very rich, that is you.} {align:justify|You must know the Bhikkhu, child. Giving half a cake when you're hungry, thanks to that, you can be confident in listening to the Buddha's teachings, be enlightened and realize the results. Because of this, I have a destiny with you, who knows, maybe in this life I will come to gather or meet with you, working together to propagate the Buddha's teachings... As long as you constantly practice diligently and diligently meditate, one day you will understand everything.} {align:justify|As for those who do not succeed in business, most of them are because they did not give alms in their previous life or in this life, or in the past they did not give alms. create many other obstacles. If you want to change your destiny, you must know how to give alms, do many charitable things for the benefit of the country, benefit the people... and especially do not kill, commit adultery, and be deluded. If you practice perseverance, your career will be successful one day.} {align:justify|Those who are rich but then their money is lost, mostly because they spend money to create karma, such as: creating prosperous karma, because they want to eat delicious food and create a lot of killing karma. Unrighteousness (such as making money by creating karma of killing, religion, lust, and delusion). Once the cause and conditions are ripe, evil consequences will appear. Therefore, those who make a living according to evil karma should change careers soon, must preserve their body, speech, and mind, correct their bad behavior, repent of their sins, abandon evil and practice good deeds...will change the evil consequences of the future."} {align:justify|(Next is the second story also related to THE ROAD TO GET RICH):}

tom_tat: Nghiem Dai Lay Buddhist is quite a famous figure among monasteries in the country. The reason people call him "Dai Lay Buddhist" is because of three things: First: he is very rich, owning many businesses across major cities in the world.
noi_dung: {align:justify|Nghiem Dai Lay Buddhist is quite a famous figure among monasteries in the country. The reason people call him "Dai Lay Buddhist" is because of three things: First: he is very rich, owning many businesses across major cities in the country. Second: the strong heart of printing sutras, creating statues, making offerings, and giving alms is extremely strong. Third: hot temper is equally great...} {align:justify|Someone like Nghiem Dai Lay Buddhist here, I have long heard of, but only now had the opportunity to get to know him, when he came to pay his respects to Venerable Dieu Phap.} {align:justify|He is about sixty years old, but his hair is all white. At first glance, he did not appear to be a wealthy man, but on the contrary, he looked exactly like an old retired employee. He wore a blue shirt, blue pants that were also wrinkled, and travel shoes on his feet, which were also unkempt.} {align:justify|This disheveled appearance rarely attracts people's attention. But because I have heard a lot about his achievements, he is famous for being someone who "treats money like trash" and is very generous. Someone said: he had a golden Buddha statue, very precious, as long as visitors admired and praised him... he immediately offered it with both hands. Whenever we come across good Buddhist scriptures, we immediately arrange for them to be printed. The quantity must at least fill a twenty-ton container. If he goes to any temple, as soon as he finds tables, chairs, dishes, dishes, etc. (meaning that the temple's items are not enough for use or are damaged), he immediately spends a huge amount of money to support.} {align:justify|Later he declared: - "Now I will not give money anymore but will directly buy the items the temple needs to bring." Because when he discovered that there was a Lay Buddhist in the monastery who received money from him, not only did he not buy things, but he also disappeared.} {align:justify|-If I make offerings that create an opportunity for them to go to hell, I am also guilty, so from now on I will only provide transportation and not give money! – he rolled his eyes and said with a very angry look –} {align:justify|He also carved a 22m tall statue of Avalokitesvara out of fragrant wood for that temple, gilding the entire thing with two kilograms of gold, spending more than hundreds of thousands of yuan.} {align:justify|The Venerable Dieu Phap invited him to sit and gently asked:} {align:justify|– I heard about you earlier, is there something that wants my heart, are you now retired? no?} {align:justify|Nghiem Lay Buddhist said that his legs have difficulty walking, feeling very heavy, in addition to having headaches for the past ten years, he has been examined at all famous hospitals both domestically and internationally, spending a lot of money, but to no avail.} {align:justify|He also visited several living Buddhas in Tibet, asking for empowerment, but the headaches still could not be stopped. Currently, he entrusts the enterprise to his children, recites Buddha's name himself, and goes back and forth to monasteries. In fact, he wanted to pray to the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas for blessings to alleviate his illness. Otherwise, he would be depressed all the time while sleeping, so he would often get angry.} {align:justify|He honestly told his master:} {align:justify|– I understand that money and power, no matter how great, cannot overcome the force of karma and cannot help relieve all worries. So these past few years I have tried my best to do some work for Buddhism, hoping that in the future when I die I can be reborn peacefully without suffering. After reading the book "Retribution for Life", I learned about my master's name. Through many exchanges and a lot of searching, I finally found out where he lived, so I took the liberty of going to pay my respects... I also understood that he was in seclusion and did not receive visitors, but I still stubbornly tried to come to the door, asking the Venerable to be merciful and understanding and forgive me. I really wanted to know, why I have created so many merits for Buddhism, big and small, and have even been vegetarian for so many years, not only The headache doesn't heal, but my legs also have problems. I hope the Venerable will be merciful Dharma Talk.} {align:justify|The Venerable said:} {align:justify|– Lay Buddhists should not be polite, the reason they do not receive guests is because they do not have enough strength. When the book "Retribution for the Life" was not yet released, I could preach Cause and Effect to warn people, but when the book came out, it became like an "advertisement" about me, causing many readers to not understand the religion I only know how to seek outwardly, go everywhere to find Venerable Dieu Phap, turn me into a miracle doctor, doing so is too wrong. If I don't know how to seek inwardly and correct my speech and conduct, even if I meet Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, I will not be able to separate from suffering and attain happiness.} {align:justify|I don't need to discuss your other matters, your level of education is not high, but do you know why your career is so successful?} {align:justify|Nghiem Lay Buddhist answer:} {align:justify|– Yes… this is thanks to the country's good policies.} {align:justify|Master said:} {align:justify|– Saying that is only a part of fate, there are many people opening factories all over the country, but very few are as successful as you.} {align:justify|Nghiem Lay Buddhist asked:} {align:justify|– So… it must be thanks to the karma sown in your previous life?} {align:justify|Master said:} {align:justify|– Why do I mention this to you? Because it's related to his headache. Ah, why didn't your wife go with you?} {align:justify|– Originally, my wife and children also planned to go, but because the house had a German dog. If she leaves, no one will take care of it. Master, why do you ask about her?} {align:justify|Master said: – Because wherever you go, your wife always carries tangerines with you?} {align:justify|Nghiem Lay Buddhist smiled and replied:} {align:justify|– Yes, that's right! Everywhere I go, she wants to follow me. I feel uneasy when I'm far away. Sometimes I feel a bit bothered...} {align:justify|Master said seriously:} {align:justify|– Can I tell you a story? But after hearing this, don't get angry!} {align:justify|Nghiem Lay Buddhist respectfully said:} {align:justify|– I don't dare. I've seen "Retribution in the Present Life" and came to it because I heard you preach like that. After speaking, he immediately bowed three times.} {align:justify|Master said:} {align:justify|-"A hundred years ago, there was an orphan boy about ten years old, who went to beg for food and then drifted to a temple located halfway up the mountain. The abbot asked about the boy, saw that he was helpless and had no place to live, so he pitifully took him in, let him live in an empty room in the temple, work as a handyman, and when needed, sent him down the mountain to go shopping.} {align:justify|After that, I don't know where he picked up a yellow dog. One night, when he went down the mountain, the dog accompanied him, helping him gain more courage. Every time he returned to the temple, the yellow dog always came to the door and barked "woo woof" to call someone to help him. A female devotee from under the mountain went to visit the pagoda, seeing young and old girls and boys happily worshiping Buddha, burning incense, and having fun, the boy yearned for it even more, admiring himself and often talking to the dog:} {align:justify|– I just need to marry a loyal wife like you in the future. I'll be with you every day, it's a great company!} {align:justify|Another day, all the guests had left. He had some doubts in his heart and immediately went to the main hall to burn incense. Standing in front of the Buddha statue, he raised his head and admired the sanctuary for a long time, then muttered to himself:} {align:justify|– "Buddha! I don't know if you are real or not." "If that's true, then please let me be a little rich so I can own things."...} {align:justify|As he was talking, he suddenly heard the Venerable's voice ringing behind him:} {align:justify|– Aren't you dreaming of getting rich?} {align:justify|He turned around and said:} {align:justify|– Dear Master, who wouldn't want to get rich? If I'm rich, I can start a family. then…} {align:justify|The monk said:} {align:justify|– Correct! If you are wealthy, you can start a family and start a business, but no matter how rich you are, everyone must grow old, get sick, and sooner or later die amid the cries of their children saying goodbye, do you think that's true?} {align:justify|He listened to the master, was stunned for a moment and then asked:} {align:justify|– So even if you are rich, you won't be happy for many years, once you get sick and die... will you still be miserable?} {align:justify|– That's right! No one can escape the process of "birth, old age, illness, death". At the time of death, they still have to leave empty-handed, the body is buried in the grave, rotting... and eventually turns into dust. As for the spirit, it continues to reincarnate, reincarnated as a buffalo or a horse, experiencing the endless suffering of life and death.} {align:justify|– Master, is there really such a thing as reincarnation?} {align:justify|The monk pointed to the dog next to him, explain:} {align:justify|– So, this Golden boy in his past life was a novice monk in the temple. He had a mole on the tail of his right eyebrow. Because when he was serving rice, he secretly ate a dumpling. When Tri Kho discovered that there was a dumpling missing, he firmly denied it, even swearing:} {align:justify|– “If I secretly eat a dumpling, I will turn into a dog in the future!”…} {align:justify|Then The novice monk was sick and died. Indeed, he reincarnated into a dog and came to this temple.When you brought the dog here, I immediately recognized it. Now look carefully at the tail of its right eyebrow, is there really a brown mole?} {align:justify|Hearing what the Venerable said, the boy was a bit skeptical, so he bent down and raised his hand to trace the hair near the tail of the dog's eyebrow to see. He exclaimed in surprise:} {align:justify|– Oh my god! There are indeed moles here! Master, this dog has been following me for so many years, I didn't know, yet master discovered that it had a mole!"... (Hearing this, Nghiem Lay Buddhist seemed very excited).} {align:justify|Monk Dieu Phap continued:} {align:justify|"The Abbot told the boy:} {align:justify|– People who make mistakes must have the courage to admit their mistakes and correct them, they cannot hide them, stubbornly deny them, and then use oaths. poison to prove his innocence. If the person in question is not at fault, it's okay, but if you keep lying and swearing carelessly - sooner or later the oath will come true -} {align:justify|After the dog has paid its karma, it is reincarnated as a human and continues to practice.} {align:justify|-Master, then what should we do to avoid continuing the cycle of suffering? – The boy asked.} {align:justify|The abbot said:} {align:justify|– People do not know when they will die, so they must quickly practice and become a monk to put an end to life and death. You can also practice at home, get married and have children, but of course the monastic life has fewer obstacles.} {align:justify|– So if you want to become a monk and practice life and death, will the master accept you? – The boy asked again.} {align:justify|The abbot smiled and replied:} {align:justify|-I have been waiting for this sentence from you for a long time!”…} {align:justify|Venerable Dieu Phap continued:} {align:justify|“After becoming a novice monk, he was determined to practice liberation from the three worlds in this life, and worked very hard. But after only a few years, he fell ill and passed away, and his wish was not fulfilled. Many years have passed until now, he was born into this world, and should have continued to become a monk to fulfill his past wishes. But in his past life, before becoming a monk, he had many other dreams. And those seeds of thought have now come to fruition.} {align:justify|As for the yellow dog, thanks to the merit of taking care of the house and temple in his previous life, he also transferred to the human world, reincarnated as a beautiful girl, and moreover, "in accordance with the wish" of that orphan boy, in this life he was destined to become his wife"...} {align:justify|At this point, Venerable Dieu Phap smiled and asked Nghiem Lay Buddhist:} {align:justify|– You know who I'm talking about, right?} {align:justify|Nghiem Lay Buddhist nodded excitedly, responding. replied:} {align:justify|– I know, as soon as the master said it, it was clear to me, my wife and I have a mole on the tail of your eyebrow!} {align:justify|The Venerable said:} {align:justify|– The reason why you are blessed in this life is because of the kindness in your previous life that you devoted all your energy to the temple. As for the headache, as long as you become a monk, the pain in your legs is due to the time you worked, gave gifts, and accepted bribes karma, combined with many heavy sins, how can I walk easily?} {align:justify|After speaking, the Venerable greeted the guest:} {align:justify|– If you truly repent of your karma, your illness will be over. Let Qua Khanh take care of your meal and I will tell you everything, and I will satisfy you with what you want to do!} {align:justify|Nghiem Lay Buddhist quickly bowed, bowed and said:} {align:justify|– Thank you very much for your Dharma Talk, I will think about becoming a monk.} {align:justify|In the end, whether Nghiem Lay Buddhist became a monk or not, this is not important at all. Nowadays, aren't everyone eager to become rich?} {align:justify|I wrote this story down to share and tell everyone the way to get rich: That's in print. Propagate the Dharma and make offerings to Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha. No matter how good your fate is, if you don't sow, you can't reap the fruit. Just like if you don't plant, no matter how fertile the land is given to you, you can't reap anything!}

tieu_de: 30. WHEN I KNOW THE Dharma of Buddha
tom_tat: My name is Truong Lap Hoa, 65 years old this year, a retired worker. I was born in the old society, raised in the new regime. From the moment I started school until now, I have absorbed an atheist education, so for the past half...
noi_dung: {align:justify|My name is Truong Lap Hoa, 65 years old this year, a retired worker. I was born in the old society, raised in the new regime. From the moment I started school until now, I have absorbed an atheist education, so during half a century of indoctrination... it can be affirmed that my mind... is full of atheism.} {align:justify|In my youth, outside of studying and working, I read a lot of novels with frivolous content, there are some books that mention Cause and Effect, but the things in the books are all ancient, old stories... from hundreds of years, even thousands of years ago, although there are moral, but there is no evidence, so it does not arouse my interest in Cause and Effect.} {align:justify|This year, my old friend and I were lucky enough to enter the realm of "pure and true", especially a group of us seniors often go to the garden to rest. There is a lady named Truong, (we call her Truong Lay Buddhist) who often tells people stories related to Cause and Effect. I also heard my partner mention this incident, but before that I didn't pay attention.} {align:justify|In March of this year, I went to the garden to visit, happened to meet Truong Lay Buddhist telling stories to everyone, and accidentally I became an audience (because I was also there). After listening for a while, I realized that these (very interesting) stories of good and evil Cause and Effect are all real stories of real people right in this life.} {align:justify|After Truong Lay Buddhist heard me tell about my suffering, she immediately gave me the book "Retribution in Life". This book broke my decades-long coma, helping me wake up.} {align:justify|What Venerable Dieu Phap explained, Dharma Talk in the book, It is truly inconceivable. The illnesses of the characters in the book are explained and presented by the Venerable very realistically: there is nothing that is not due to killing, there is nothing that is not due to Cause and Effect, because of the desire for delicious food that creates evil karma. In the book, it is said: "Stewing meat to satisfy their cravings, who knows that they die unwillingly, the kitchen turns into a place of massacre, disembowelment, dismemberment to the mountain of execution" and cooking, stir-frying, grilling, roasting, braising... is committing the crime of humanity. Unlucky things will sooner or later be punished.} {align:justify|I have had diabetes for 17 years, resulting in stiff limbs and retinal complications. I went to major hospitals and the doctor diagnosed: "I can no longer see in my right eye, and my left eye has only one-tenth of my vision. My vision is extremely impaired." I was very scared, shocked, and extremely miserable.} {align:justify|Because once my left eye can no longer see, won't I become blind? In the past, I always thought that eating meat would help my body stay healthy, it was so wrong, so wrong!} {align:justify|Thanks to the book "Retribution for Life" that I received Dharma Talk, I was determined: right here to practice and change my life. I swear from now on forever not to kill, not to eat salty food, not to eat any animal meat and in my heart often look towards the Sentient Beings who have been eaten by me, sincerely repent, recite Buddha's Dedication of Merit to bless them...} {align:justify|From March to June of this year, counting more than three months, miracles have occurred. I didn't spend a dime to go to the ophthalmology hospital, but now (except for the cataract in my right eye), my left eye's vision has returned to normal as before (I'm writing this paragraph myself). If from November last year to February this year, according to the progression of the disease like that, then my left eye would definitely be blind. But because I knew how to repent, fast, practice... miracles appeared, oh! As Buddha and Venerable Dieu Phap have given me light, I am truly grateful and deeply impressed.} {align:justify|In June of this year, through introduction, I was fortunate to meet the author Qua Khanh, and also met with my own eyes some of the characters mentioned in the book, the main roles in stories such as: "The fetus loves to listen to the Ksitigarbha Sutra", "Reciting the precepts and reciting the Buddha's name benefits", "The feeling of heaven and earth"... These people sat next to me, listening to Lay Buddhism together. Qua Khanh preaches the Dharma, why doesn't he make me admire and admire him?} {align:justify|Now I have Receiving and Upholding the five precepts and are vegetarian, My partner and I have both taken refuge in Buddhism, these years of our survival are: learning} {align:justify|Buddha, reciting Buddha's name, becoming a true good Buddhist disciple, being lay Buddhists practicing authentically at home, this is truly our reward!} {align:justify|The result Khanh notes:} {align:justify|(In December, when I met Lay Buddhist Truong Lap Hoa again, he had changed for the better, completely different, his diabetes had healed and he was no longer taking any medication).}

tieu_de: 31. IN THE Dharma There is the Dharma
tom_tat: Question: -In the age of the end of the dharma, there are too many people who preach evil dharma, and there are even more people who do not follow the precepts. Is it true that from now on, Buddhism will become more and more impaired and unable to spread? Answer: – Not so...
noi_dung: {align:justify|Question: -In the age of the end of the dharma, there are too many people preaching evil dharma, and even more people not following the precepts. Is it true that from now on, Buddhism will increasingly decline and be unable to spread?} {align:justify|Answer: – Not so. As far as I know, regardless of the monastic or lay world, there are many people who secretly practice. I don't have the opportunity to discuss about monks, I can only tell you the stories of Lay Buddhist's actual practice at home. In "Retribution for the Present Life Volume 1, I have summarized the story of "Teaching Mister" and now I would like to explain more clearly:} {align:justify|This couple, the husband is 29 years old this year, his wife is 32 years old. Their child was diagnosed with cerebral palsy. The child is now 4 years old, looks very smart and beautiful.} {align:justify|Intelligence, and IQ measurements are much higher than those of children much older than him. For example, if you play a magic trick with him. When a child hides something, he not only knows you're tricking him, but can immediately find the object you're hiding. When he walks, he's very shy because he can't keep his balance. He has to be guided by an adult to walk. He's still trying to practice, but compared to what the doctor said: "This baby won't be able to sit," he can say simple words to his father, mother, grandmother, etc call parents, or pat her belly, point to her mouth. When she wants to urinate, she calls her parents or expresses it with movements. Or the thing is that at night she doesn't even urinate on the bed. Whenever she needs to urinate, she knows to wake up her parents and express it.} {align:justify|If the child's favorite person comes to visit, as soon as they speak outside the house, the child is waving his arms and legs happily Ba: -“Sir!” Without needing to tell her parents, I looked at her progress and felt very happy and comforted.} {align:justify|The Venerable Dieu Phap gave the baby the name Hue Han, today it has indeed come true.} {align:justify|Master said:} {align:justify|– Hue Han's change and progress are faster than I thought. In the future, not only will she be able to handle it herself, but she will be completely normal and will also be able to open her mind in advance. at the age of 20.} {align:justify|I was very surprised after hearing this and asked my master:} {align:justify|– Hue Han was reincarnated from the animal world (of the pig species), how could she open her wisdom?} {align:justify|The master replied:} {align:justify|– The teacher, because he said nonsense: "What Buddhism preaches is all lies!", also used his reputation as a guarantee, missing out on many people's opportunity to study Buddhism, so after his death he was reborn as a pig, but in a previous life, this teacher had once He was a very famous monk (at that time). Later, because his mind was not pure, he died and returned to the human world. Similarly, his two disciples, because their love was not broken, came to the human world and became his students. Because of his wrong views, he destroyed many people's opportunity to study Buddhism. tieu_de: 37. VI WHY DID YOU TAKE A TU?
tom_tat: In the fall of 2003, on a beautiful clear day with a gentle breeze, my old friend and I went to the famous Ban Long Pagoda in Nguyen Thi district, Hebei province. After burning incense to worship Buddha, we took a walk to admire the scenery in...
noi_dung: {align:justify|In the fall of 2003, on a beautiful clear day with a gentle breeze, my old friend and I went to the famous Ban Long Pagoda in Nguyen Thi district, Hebei province. After burning incense and offering offerings to Buddha, we walked around to admire the scenery in the temple. Suddenly, a nun with a bright face greeted us with a smile. She looked very gentle and friendly. My fake friend stepped forward to say hello:} {align:justify|– Dear Master, we are Lay Buddhists from far away visiting the temple, can we talk to you?} {align:justify|She quickly replied: – Amitabha Buddha! Okay!} {align:justify|I speak up:} {align:justify|– Dear lady, you are still very young, why do you want to become a monk?} {align:justify|So the nun brought a real scary story (that she personally witnessed) and told us.} {align:justify|” I was born into a family of powerful officials in city Since I was young, I just went to school until I graduated from the University of Finance. After graduating, he worked at an agency for more than ten years, then transferred to work at a bank. My husband works in a government agency, and my son is in high school. I always feel that my life is very happy, I have loving parents, a warm family, and nothing to worry about at home. Everything is very convenient. But three years ago, I encountered a major incident that changed my life greatly and turned in a different direction.} {align:justify|Three years ago I worked at a bank, and also held the position of "Real Estate Company Finance Officer".} {align:justify|The General Director of the Real Estate Company is 46 years old, rich and powerful, in the past he worked at a Food Company, then switched to real estate business. He is incredibly rich, owns tens of thousands of assets, has a great business, and is very powerful.} {align:justify|That year he played stocks and lost heavily. That day, in just fifteen minutes, more than 4700,000 had to be paid. He was hit too hard by a rock, so he suffered a brain hemorrhage and died.} {align:justify|After he died, his consciousness stayed with me. When he was alive, he was 1m84 tall, but now when we see him, he is only about 1m tall, with skin the color of earth. His appearance is exactly the same as when he was alive. As soon as I looked, I immediately knew that this was Mr. General. At that time, no matter where I went, he followed me. I can't close my eyes.because as soon as I aim, my headache is unbearable. Even if I close my eyes, I can still see him.} {align:justify|My family thought I was abnormal, so they sent someone to watch over me all day. But the situation I saw, no one else saw. So no matter what I said or described what I saw, no one would believe me. I wanted to escape Mr. President but I couldn't. I took a plane to Beijing or Qingdao and he was with me. This scene tormented me for 100 days.} {align:justify|What's even more terrifying is that, after his death, every 7 days is a full week, every time I pass through a cell, before my eyes I see scenes of hell, where he suffered, seeing him being punished miserably and horribly.} {align:justify|The first week of the cell, I saw the prisoners come and drag his hands and stuff them into the incinerator, only to hear his pitiful screams. When his hand was pulled out, it was crooked and red like hot iron, and his body was convulsed.} {align:justify|In the second week, before my eyes was a hell of burning feet, in the third week, I saw him climbing barefoot on a mountain of knives, blood pouring out, in the 5th, 6th, and 1st weeks, I saw him being dismembered, disemboweled, eyes gouged out, legs amputated, etc. It was so pathetic and horrifying that I didn't dare to look at it. I also heard him groan loudly, begging me to save him (But I did not know Buddhism at that time, so I did not know how to save him).} {align:justify|For 100 days; Finally, the landscape appeared, I suddenly saw Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara standing on a pink lotus, wearing white clothes, his appearance was dignified and unsurpassed. I looked at Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara's pure charisma, overwhelmed by the brilliant light before my eyes, my body and mind immediately felt clear and refreshed.} {align:justify|Just listen to Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara's earnest words:} {align:justify|– You must recite the Buddha's name!} {align:justify|Then he lightly waved his sleeve, and in the blink of an eye he disappeared.} {align:justify|I quickly cried out, shook my roommate awake, and told her about the scene where I saw Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. So we went together to buy incense, a censer and a statue of Avalokitesvara.} {align:justify|When I burned the first incense stick, I saw Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara in the blink of an eye merging into one with the statue of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara, then heard him teach:} {align:justify|– Let's go to Bao Hoa Temple! (Bao Hoa Temple in Liaoning, Dalian Province)} {align:justify|So my friend and I went to Bao Hoa Temple, the monk in the temple seemed to know in advance that I would come, as soon as he saw me, he immediately said:} {align:justify|– I have been waiting for you for a long time!} {align:justify|The monk also said:} {align:justify|– You need to become a monk!} {align:justify|On June 19, the monk performed a prayer ceremony for the General. At that time, I felt the earth tremble, saw the President being rescued from hell, and saw countless arms reaching out from hell, as if calling for help. After the transcendence, the monk told me:} {align:justify|– The General has been saved from hell and reincarnated into the animal world.} {align:justify|One year later, also on September 16, I was walking on a nearby road when I happened to meet a donkey. As soon as it saw me, it refused to walk, calling it tears. I don't understand why this happened. Returning to the temple to ask the assistant teacher, he said:} {align:justify|– This donkey is your General Director!} {align:justify|So relatives and friends quickly went everywhere to look for the donkey, but could not find it.} {align:justify|Another year passed, that day was April 28, the donkey let go of its leash and ran to the temple gate, no matter how much people dragged or drowned it, it cried and refused to go.} {align:justify|At that time The abbot was meditating, but he still told me:} {align:justify|– There's a donkey outside looking for you!} {align:justify|I quickly ran out the gate, my donkey's body quickly ran to me, crying and tears} {align:justify|I told it:} {align:justify|– Are you General Director X? If so, then nod.} {align:justify|He heard and understood what I said, immediately nodded.} {align:justify|Then I said:} {align:justify|– I take refuge with you, please listen.} {align:justify|I immediately followed the way my master taught, taking refuge in the Three Jewels for the donkey. After the ceremony, I said:} {align:justify|– Now lead me to your master's house!} {align:justify|The donkey nodded. It went first, I followed behind and watched it walk on the road just like the General when he was alive.} {align:justify|When we got there, the donkey looked at me and then at the owner (as if to tell me that this was his owner). I asked him when the donkey was born? When he said day, month, year...It was calculated to be consistent with the general's extraordinary time. Right there, I was sure that this was the General who escaped from hell and was reborn as an animal in the human world.} {align:justify|Then the General's family came to ransom the donkey and released it in the temple.} {align:justify|This incident shocked the minds of many people. Originally, the company owed the bank a huge amount of money (about seven thousand thousand), but when the General was still alive, he did not want to pay, so since this "earth-shattering" incident happened and everyone at the company witnessed it with their own eyes, the Deputy General Director of the company immediately directed the bank to pay the entire debt. After payment, the company still had money left over.} {align:justify|Most of my relatives, friends and colleagues after that incident All take refuge in Buddhism. Because I personally experienced this event, I deeply believe that the six paths of reincarnation are real, and secretly understand that the law of Cause and Effect of retribution is not wrong at all. Why did he fall into hell and experience all the painful punishments? Of course it's due to bad causes (but that's your personal matter, I don't want to bring it up). The important thing is that his story has made many people awaken, be alert, know how to self-regulate and repair their bodies and minds more carefully.} {align:justify|Even if you are rich now and own tens of thousands of assets, once you die you won't be able to take a penny with you! Just as the ancients once said: "You can't take away all things, only karma carries you with you!"...} {align:justify|I was born into a wealthy family as a child, and a family with a powerful position. Counting all the animals that fly in the sky, walk on the ground, and swim in the water, there's nothing that I haven't eaten. The evil karma created is certainly very deep. I thought to myself: "In the future, if I and my parents, relatives... fall into hell, then who will save us?} {align:justify|So I made up my mind to become a monk and vow to practice until we reach the ultimate enlightenment."} {align:justify|After she finished telling the story, she was still very emotional, sadly sighing.} {align:justify|We were shocked by her story, our spirituality was strongly attacked, because of the knowledge I had known about the six paths of reincarnation and Cause and Effect of retribution before, all of which I had only read in books, so I felt very far away from understanding.But the real story told by the nun just happened right in the 21st century. Real times, places, real people, real events are clearly laid out before our eyes, how can we not be startled?} {align:justify|Please record this to share with readers.}

tieu_de: 38. WHY DO MONKS GET SERIOUSLY Ill?

Why do you have to commit a crime there? The monk said:} {align:justify|– He committed the crime of promiscuity (seducing little girls and ruining their lives) so he had to receive this punishment.} {align:justify|I remember when he lived in this world, Mr. sin, I don't know when will I be free from suffering? The monk replied: - He has no great sin, just an irresponsible husband (because his wife was unfilial and did not advise).} {align:justify|Soon we arrived at an office building, this is a building, I knew my brother was upstairs, so I walked up the stairs, saw my brother sitting and pushing some numbers on the abacus, I was happy and called out: - Brother!} {align:justify|But you are just like the relatives I have met here, completely He couldn't see or hear me, didn't know anything about my presence, so he couldn't communicate.} {align:justify|The monk urged me to go again and again, going through countless routes. Seeing me, he immediately asked:} {align:justify|– What did you come to do?} {align:justify|Before I could answer, the monk nodded. My father also nodded as if he understood what he meant. I didn't dare argue so I continued.} {align:justify|Not long after I came to a bridge, about 14-15 cm wide. As soon as I set foot on it, I was so scared that I quickly retreated, terrified.
